saw_lines: Men buy ethnic wear for one date, a wedding or Diwali, and they judge the fit before the day.
So the sale is decided by whether the ad names the occasion, the fit or the offer before people scroll.
Your site offers subscribe and save at 40% off, but 0 of 21 ads mention it. Put the offer in the first line of three new Navratri kurta ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers subscribe and save at 40% off, but 0 of 21 ads mention it. A buyer has no reason to act today. Put the offer in the first line of three new Navratri kurta ads and on the creative.

None of your 28 ads mention a subscription, though your site sells one. Repeat buyers never hear the saving exists. Run two retention ads for past buyers with the subscription saving as the headline, one on the kurta jacket set.

Your site explains how the order arrives, yet 0 of 28 ads show it. Buyers pay for a festive set without seeing how it arrives. Show the box arriving and opening in one video ad, with delivery time on screen.

None of your 21 written ads carries a proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust. Take one figure from your store, like orders shipped or a review count, and open two of three new Navratri kurta ads with it.
